fallback.label_zh: Fallback-Possible：無一般Picked／Possible時的最可能候選；低信心，肺炎歸因未確認

constraints: The user requested at least one reported candidate and explicit inclusion of Fallback-Possible in positive prediction evaluation.
Selection and clinical evidence are separate: fallback does not upgrade activity or organ attribution.
Check the entire patient's candidates, not only the CMV/viral subset, before preserving fallback.
Do not add fallback alongside an ordinary Picked or Possible.
Preserve only an existing selected, credible fallback; this scoped patch does not implement a new cross-pathogen ranker.
No candidate or failed/uninterpretable detection cannot be made positive merely to satisfy a quota.
Explicit resolved/shedding evidence requires review, not blind restoration.
No patient IDs, benchmark answers or species-specific performance tuning enter the finalization rule.
Unknown assay independence remains unknown unless the exact source row is explicitly verified.
